_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution" TEXT NULL, "last4" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER NULL, "statement_day" INTEGER NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NULL, "balance_anchor_minor" INTEGER NULL, "balance_anchor_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "issuer" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "network" TEXT NULL, "annual_fee_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "min_salary_minor" INTEGER NULL, "reward_structure" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "perks" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "verified_on" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "catalog_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_cards (id), "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "nickname" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slug" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "is_fixed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_fixed" IN (0, 1)), "icon" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "budget_group" TEXT NULL, "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), "rollover_start" TEXT NULL, "rollover_start_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cycle_cost_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cycle_months" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "statement_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_raw" TEXT NULL, "merchant_normalized" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "posted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_hash" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "exclude_from_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_budget" IN (0, 1)), "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sources" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "statement_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("statement_locked" IN (0, 1)), "applied_rule_id" TEXT NULL, "reviewed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reviewed" IN (0, 1)), "receipt_ref" TEXT NULL, "receipt_notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("category_id", "month"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "conditions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "rename_merchant" TEXT NULL, "mark_transfer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mark_transfer" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_from_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_budget" IN (0, 1)), "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "statements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "period_start" TEXT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "closing_balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "parse_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "reconciliation_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "diff_minor" INTEGER NULL, "institution" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'upload', "file_sha256" TEXT NULL, "original_filename" TEXT NULL, "parse_error" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "statement_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES statements (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "posted_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "foreign_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "foreign_currency" TEXT NULL, "balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "match_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unmatched', "match_score" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("statement_id", "line_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "cost_basis_minor" INTEGER NULL, "manual_value_minor" INTEGER NULL, "valuation_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "valued_at" INTEGER NULL, "acquired_on" TEXT NULL, "market_value_minor" INTEGER NULL, "market_valued_at" INTEGER NULL, "valuation_note" TEXT NULL, "meta" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "liabilities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lender" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "principal_minor" INTEGER NULL, "outstanding_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interest_rate_bps" INTEGER NULL, "emi_minor" INTEGER NULL, "next_due_on" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "salary_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "employer" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "received_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id), "matched_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saved_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "target_date" TEXT NULL, "monthly_contribution_minor" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'save', "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "linked_ref" TEXT NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_contributions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "on_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_ingests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "parse_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "parse_result" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "net_worth_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "assets_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "liabilities_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_worth_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breakdown" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_reviews" ("series_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "source" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live', "quoted_at" INTEGER NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jewellery_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "karat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purity_override" REAL NULL, "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "making_charges_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "photo_paths" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "approximate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("approximate" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "file_paths" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "due_on" TEXT NULL, "due_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expiry', "remind_days_before" INTEGER NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fund_holdings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheme_code" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "units" REAL NOT NULL, "avg_cost_nav" REAL NULL, "nav" REAL NOT NULL, "nav_date" TEXT NULL, "nav_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "nav_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "sip_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "sip_day" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "valuation_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("subject_kind", "subject_id", "snapshot_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_configs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "my_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "share_mine" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("share_mine" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "split" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_limits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AED', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_mirror" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "row_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_moves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me', "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_prefs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flex', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_choices" ("series_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "choice" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "decided_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("series_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "where_to_find" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "nominee_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contact_person" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "estimated_value_minor" INTEGER NULL, "photo_paths" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_nominees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "relationship" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contact" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "entry_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '*', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_holdings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "avg_cost" REAL NULL, "last_price" REAL NULL, "price_at" INTEGER NULL, "price_source" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "approximate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("approximate" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investing_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investing_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "price" REAL NULL, "units" REAL NULL, "decided_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("rule_id", "due_date"));
CREATE INDEX ix_transactions_posted_at ON transactions (posted_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_transactions_account_posted ON transactions (account_id, posted_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_transactions_statement ON transactions (statement_id)
